cohort: The study included 141 pregnant women with GDM and 141 non-GDM pregnant women reporting to a tertiary care hospital in Tamil Nadu, India.
finding: GDM was significantly associated with higher rates of preeclampsia, urinary tract infection, preterm labor, postpartum hemorrhage, elevated mean birth weight signifying macrosomia risk, and neonatal hyperbilirubinemia.
mod_finding: No significant differences were reported in the mode of delivery between the GDM and non-GDM neonates.
